报道.en: Tom wrote a very profound report.

报道.zh: 关于这个问题，我觉得垃圾媒体只报道了很片面的信息。
报道.pinyin: Guān yú zhè ge wèn tí wǒ jué de lā jī méi tǐ zhǐ bào dào le hěn piàn miàn de xìn xī
报道.en: Concerning this issue, I feel that the trash media only report biased information.

报道.zh: 他觉得必须报道这件事。
报道.pinyin: Tā jué de bì xū bào dào zhè jiàn shì
报道.en: He felt compelled to report the incident.

醋.pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào mǎi cù
Yòng níng méng zhī dài tì cù
醋.en: Use lemon juice instead of vinegar.

湿润.zh: 因为气候又暖和又湿润，所以广州一年到头都有花。
湿润.pinyin: Yīn wèi qì hòu yòu nuǎn huo yòu shī rùn suǒ yǐ guǎng zhōu yī nián dào tóu dōu yǒu huā
湿润.en: With a warm and wet climate, Guangzhou has fresh flowers all year round.
湿润.es: Teniendo un clima húmedo y cálido, Guangzhou tiene flores de la estación durante todo el año.

省略.pinyin: Shěng lüè diào wú yòng de cí
Wǒ shěng lüè le shén me

片面.zh: 事物都有两面性。极端的人只看得见片面。
片面.pinyin: Shì wù dōu yǒu liǎng miàn xìng jí duān de rén zhǐ kàn de jiàn piàn miàn
片面.en: Everything has two sides. Fanatics only see one.

栋.pinyin: Nà dòng fáng zi shì wǒ de

栋.zh: 山上的那栋建筑物就是我们的学校了。
栋.pinyin: Shān shàng de nà dòng jiàn zhù wù jiù shì wǒ men de xué xiào le
栋.en: The building on the hill is our school.
栋.es: El edificio en la colina es nuestra escuela.

栋.zh: 我家的旁边建了一栋高楼。
栋.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de páng biān jiàn le yī dòng gāo lóu
栋.en: A tall building was built next to my house.
栋.es: Un edificio alto fue construido al lado de mi casa.

栋.pinyin: Tā yǒu yī dòng zì jǐ de fáng zi
栋.en: He has a house of his own.

暗示.zh: 您是在暗示我太年轻了吗？
暗示.pinyin: Nín shì zài àn shì wǒ tài nián qīng le ma
暗示.en: Are you suggesting that I'm too young?

暗示.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì xiǎng àn shì shén me
Tā de huà àn shì zhe shén me

暗示.zh: 他们没有人了解她暗示什么。
暗示.pinyin: Tā men méi yǒu rén liǎo jiě tā àn shì shén me
暗示.en: None of them could understand what she was implying.
暗示.es: Ninguno de ellos fue capaz de entender lo que ella estaba insinuando.

淋.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yào bīng jī lín zuò tián diǎn
淋.en: I want ice cream for dessert.

淋.es: Que no te moje la lluvia.

淋.zh: 你不该吃太多冰激淋和太多意大利面。
淋.pinyin: Nǐ bù gāi chī tài duō bīng jī lín hé tài duō yì dà lì miàn
淋.en: You mustn't eat too much ice cream and spaghetti.
淋.es: No debes comer demasiado helado y espagueti.

淋.zh: 我在回家路上被雨淋了。
淋.pinyin: Wǒ zài huí jiā lù shang bèi yǔ lín le
淋.en: I was rained on on my way home.

贫困.zh: 他怎么在这样的贫困中谋生？
贫困.pinyin: Tā zěn me zài zhè yàng de pín kùn zhōng móu shēng
贫困.en: How did he make his living in such poverty?

贫困.zh: 这个政策的目的是改善最贫困城市的环境。
贫困.pinyin: Zhè ge zhèng cè de mù dì shì gǎi shàn zuì pín kùn chéng shì de huán jìng
贫困.en: The aim of this policy is to improve the environment in the poorest cities.

贫困.zh: 我也是从农村出来的，对贫困有着切身感受。
贫困.pinyin: Wǒ yě shì cóng nóng cūn chū lái de duì pín kùn yǒu zhe qiè shēn gǎn shòu
贫困.en: I also come from the countryside, so I have a first-hand understanding of poverty.

贫困.zh: 阿尔及利亚仍国境贫困。
贫困.pinyin: Ā ěr jí lì yà réng guó jìng pín kùn

辫子.zh: 你想让我帮你编辫子吗？
辫子.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng ràng wǒ bāng nǐ biān biàn zi ma
辫子.en: Would you like me to braid your hair?
辫子.es: ¿Te gustaría que yo trence tu cabello?

辫子.pinyin: Tā de biàn zi diào le
Jiě jie jiāo wǒ biān biàn zi
辫子.en: My sister taught me how to braid hair.

辫子.zh: 汤姆把胡子编成了辫子。
辫子.pinyin: Tāng mǔ bǎ hú zi biān chéng le biàn zi

口气.zh: 我不喜欢你和我说话的口气。
口气.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐ huan nǐ hé wǒ shuō huà de kǒu qì
口气.en: I don't like the way you talk to me.
口气.es: No me gusta tu tono para hablar conmigo.

口气.zh: 贝蒂说话的口气像是她知道了一切。
口气.pinyin: Bèi dì shuō huà de kǒu qì xiàng shì tā zhī dào le yī qiè
口气.en: Betty talks as if she knew everything.
口气.es: Betty habla como si lo supiera todo.

口气.zh: 看见这副景象，我不禁叹了口气。
口气.pinyin: Kàn jiàn zhè fù jǐng xiàng wǒ bù jīn tàn le kǒu qì
口气.en: Seeing this scene, I couldn’t help but sigh.

口气.zh: 麦克以建议的口气说了些话。
口气.pinyin: Mài kè yǐ jiàn yì de kǒu qì shuō le xiē huà
口气.en: Mike said a few words by way of suggestion.

意图.zh: 一个差劲的厨师和下毒者唯一的不同在于他们的意图。
意图.pinyin: Yī ge chà jìn de chú shī hé xià dú zhě wéi yī de bù tóng zài yú tā men de yì tú
意图.en: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.
意图.es: La única diferencia entre una mala cocinera y una envenenadora es la intención.

意图.zh: 我把我的意图告诉了我父母。
意图.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ wǒ de yì tú gào su le wǒ fù mǔ
意图.en: I made known my intentions to my parents.

意图.zh: 对我们来说，最重要的是领会领导意图。
意图.pinyin: Duì wǒ men lái shuō zuì zhòng yào de shì lǐng huì lǐng dǎo yì tú
意图.en: For us, what’s most important is understanding the intention of the leadership.

意图.zh: 政府明确宣布了降税的意图。
意图.pinyin: Zhèng fǔ míng què xuān bù le jiàng shuì de yì tú
意图.en: The government clearly stated its intention to lower taxes.

生肖.zh: 很多人都会问，为什么生肖的十二种动物里没有猫呢？
生肖.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dū huì wèn wèi shén me shēng xiào de shí èr zhǒng dòng wù lǐ méi yǒu māo ne
生肖.en: A lot of people ask why the cat does not appear among the twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac.
生肖.es: Mucha gente se pregunta por qué el gato no aparece entre los doce animales del zodiaco chino.

生肖.zh: 很多人都会问，生肖的十二种动物里为什么没有猫呢？
生肖.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dū huì wèn shēng xiào de shí èr zhǒng dòng wù lǐ wèi shén me méi yǒu māo ne
生肖.en: A lot of people ask why the cat does not appear among the twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac.
生肖.es: Mucha gente se pregunta por qué el gato no aparece entre los doce animales del zodiaco chino.

生肖.zh: 每一个生肖的背后都有着数不尽的成语、谚语和故事。
生肖.pinyin: Měi yī ge shēng xiào de bèi hòu dōu yǒu zhe shǔ bù jìn de chéng yǔ yàn yǔ hé gù shi
生肖.en: Behind every animal on the Chinese zodiac lies an array of proverbs, sayings and stories.

生肖.zh: 十二生肖里没有猫的原因很简单。
生肖.pinyin: Shí èr shēng xiào lǐ méi yǒu māo de yuán yīn hěn jiǎn dān
生肖.en: The reason the cat is not included in the 12 animals of the Chinese zodiac is very simple.

竭尽全力.zh: 他为了活下去竭尽全力，所以他从来不想谈起这件事。
竭尽全力.pinyin: Tā wèi le huó xià qù jié jìn quán lì suǒ yǐ tā cóng lái bù xiǎng tán qǐ zhè jiàn shì
竭尽全力.en: He did everything to be able to survive, hence he never wants to talk about it.
竭尽全力.es: Hizo de todo para poder sobrevivir, de ahí que nunca quiera hablar de ello.

竭尽全力.zh: 医生虽然已经竭尽全力，但不久病人还是死了。
竭尽全力.pinyin: Yī shēng suī rán yǐ jīng jié jìn quán lì dàn bù jiǔ bìng rén hái shi sǐ le
竭尽全力.en: All the doctor's efforts were in vain and the man soon died.
竭尽全力.es: Todos los esfuerzos del médico fueron en vano, enseguida el hombre murió.

竭尽全力.zh: 他竭尽全力地讨好他老婆。
竭尽全力.pinyin: Tā jié jìn quán lì de tǎo hǎo tā lǎo pó
竭尽全力.en: He bent over backward to please his wife.

竭尽全力.pinyin: Tāng mǔ jié jìn quán lì zhuī gǎn
竭尽全力.en: Tom did his best to catch up.

咋.pinyin: Nǐ zǎ huā zhè bǐ qián lei
咋.en: What do you plan on doing with the money?

咋.pinyin: Nǐ jīn tiān xīn qíng zǎ yàng
Xià tiān guò dé zǎ yàng a
Wǒ men qù shì chǎng zǎ yàng
咋.en: Shall we go to the market?

反感.pinyin: Tā zhēn de ràng wǒ hěn fǎn gǎn
Tā hěn fǎn gǎn xìng ài

反感.zh: 她对被称为懦夫很反感。
反感.pinyin: Tā duì bèi chēng wéi nuò fū hěn fǎn gǎn
反感.en: She resented being called a coward.

反感.zh: 无理由乱发脾气会让别人反感。
反感.pinyin: Wú lǐ yóu luàn fā pí qì huì ràng bié ren fǎn gǎn
反感.en: Losing your temper for no reason would invite the resentment of others.

平行.zh: 平行四边形的对边平行。
平行.pinyin: Píng xíng sì biān xíng de duì biān píng xíng
平行.en: The opposite sides of a parallelogram are parallel.
平行.es: Los lados opuestos de un paralelogramo son paralelos.

平行.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yǔ hé liú píng xíng
平行.en: The road runs parallel to the river.
平行.es: El camino va paralelo al río.

平行.pinyin: Liǎng tiáo jiē dào hù xiāng píng xíng
平行.en: The two streets run parallel to one another.
平行.es: Las dos calles van paralelas la una con la otra.

平行.pinyin: Tiě lù yǔ gōng lù píng xíng
平行.en: The railroad is parallel to the road.

枯萎.zh: 我花园里的花在寒冷的天气下枯萎了。
枯萎.pinyin: Wǒ huā yuán lǐ de huā zài hán lěng de tiān qì xià kū wěi le
枯萎.en: The flowers in my garden have withered in the cold.

枯萎.zh: 所有花园里的花朵都枯萎了。
枯萎.pinyin: Suǒ yǒu huā yuán lǐ de huā duǒ dōu kū wěi le
枯萎.en: All the flowers in the garden withered.

枯萎.pinyin: Xiān huā yīn quē shuǐ ér kū wěi
枯萎.en: The flowers withered for want of water.

妥当.pinyin: Qì jīn yī qiè tuǒ dang

火焰.zh: 硫磺燃烧着蓝色的火焰。
火焰.pinyin: Liú huáng rán shāo zhe lán sè de huǒ yàn
火焰.en: Sulfur burns with a blue flame.
火焰.es: El azufre se quema con una llama azul.

火焰.zh: 用本生灯加热钾，火焰就会呈现淡紫色。
火焰.pinyin: Yòng běn shēng dēng jiā rè jiǎ huǒ yàn jiù huì chéng xiàn dàn zǐ sè
火焰.en: Potassium, heated with a Bunsen burner, gives the flame a lilac color.

信念.zh: 他的行为和他的信念背道而驰。
信念.pinyin: Tā de xíng wéi hé tā de xìn niàn bèi dào ér chí
信念.en: His behavior is contrary to his belief.

信念.zh: 我们应该尽量避免把我们自己的信念强加在别人身上。
信念.pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi jǐn liàng bì miǎn bǎ wǒ men zì jǐ de xìn niàn qiáng jiā zài bié ren shēn shang
信念.en: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.

持久.zh: 生活中绝对没有什么是持久的。
持久.pinyin: Shēng huó zhōng jué duì méi yǒu shén me shì chí jiǔ de
持久.en: Absolutely nothing is permanent in life.
持久.es: En la vida nada es para siempre.

馋.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de wǒ chán sǐ le
馋.en: The way you describe it makes me drool.

安宁.zh: 让我们享受这平静和安宁。
安宁.pinyin: Ràng wǒ men xiǎng shòu zhè píng jìng hé ān níng
安宁.en: Let's just enjoy this peace and quiet.

雕刻.zh: 这座雕像是由樱木雕刻而成。
雕刻.pinyin: Zhè zuò diāo xiàng shì yóu yīng mù diāo kè ér chéng
雕刻.en: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.

事.zh: 我期待听到你在这件事上的想法 。
事.pinyin: Wǒ qī dài tīng dào nǐ zài zhè jiàn shì shàng de xiǎng fǎ
事.en: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.
事.es: Estoy impaciente por escuchar qué piensas de este tema.

事.zh: 我没见过也没听过这样的事。
事.pinyin: Wǒ méi jiàn guo yě méi tīng guo zhè yàng de shì
事.en: I have neither seen nor heard of such a thing.
事.es: Nunca he visto o escuchado algo así.

事.zh: 老师不可能说过这样的事。
事.pinyin: Lǎo shī bù kě néng shuō guo zhè yàng de shì
事.en: The teacher cannot have said such a thing.
事.es: El profesor no pudo haber dicho algo así.

事.zh: 不要再让这种事发生了！
事.pinyin: Bù yào zài ràng zhè zhǒng shì fā shēng le
事.es: ¡No dejes que eso pase de nuevo!

英语.pinyin: Jiāo yīng yǔ shì tā de zhí yè

英语.zh: 昨天，我收到一封用英语写的信。
英语.pinyin: Zuó tiān wǒ shōu dào yī fēng yòng yīng yǔ xiě de xìn
英语.en: I received a letter written in English yesterday.
英语.es: Ayer recibí una carta escrita en inglés.

英语.zh: 是谁教她怎么说英语的？
英语.pinyin: Shì shéi jiāo tā zěn me shuō yīng yǔ de
英语.en: Who taught her how to speak English?
英语.es: ¿Quién la ha enseñado a hablar inglés?

英语.zh: 今天下午我有两个小时的英语课和两个小时的汉语课。
英语.pinyin: Jīn tiān xià wǔ wǒ yǒu liǎng gè xiǎo shí de yīng yǔ kè hé liǎng gè xiǎo shí de hàn yǔ kè
英语.en: This afternoon I have English class for two hours and then two hours of Chinese.
英语.es: Esta tarde tengo dos horas de clase de inglés y dos horas de clase de chino.

手.pinyin: Tā méi yǒu jǔ qǐ tā de shǒu
手.en: He did not put up his hand.

手.zh: 年轻人伸出他的手，接着我和他握了手。
手.pinyin: Nián qīng rén shēn chū tā de shǒu jiē zhe wǒ hé tā wò le shǒu
手.en: The young man put out his hand and I shook it.
手.es: El joven estiró su mano, y yo la estreché.

手.zh: 我总是在离手不远的地方放一本字典。
手.pinyin: Wǒ zǒng shì zài lí shǒu bù yuǎn de dì fang fàng yī běn zì diǎn
手.en: I always keep a dictionary close at hand.
手.es: Siempre tengo un diccionario a la mano.

手.zh: 他在手上贴了一块胶布。
手.pinyin: Tā zài shǒu shàng tiē le yī kuài jiāo bù
手.en: He put a Band-Aid on his hand.
手.es: Se puso una tirita en la mano.

花园.zh: 我在花园里种了些玫瑰。
花园.pinyin: Wǒ zài huā yuán lǐ zhǒng le xiē méi guī
花园.en: I planted roses in the garden.

花园.zh: 她帮她爸爸干了花园里的活。
花园.pinyin: Tā bāng tā bà ba gān le huā yuán lǐ de huó
花园.en: She helped her father with the work in the garden.
花园.es: Ella ayudó a su padre con el trabajo en el jardín.

花园.zh: 由于缺水，花园里所有的花都死了。
花园.pinyin: Yóu yú quē shuǐ huā yuán lǐ suǒ yǒu de huā dū sǐ le
花园.en: Due to the water shortage, all the flowers in the garden have died.
花园.es: Debido a la falta de agua, todas las flores del jardín se han muerto.

花园.zh: 花园里有些漂亮的花朵。
花园.pinyin: Huā yuán lǐ yǒu xiē piào liang de huā duǒ
花园.en: There are pretty flowers in the garden.
花园.es: Hay bonitas flores en el jardín.

之一.zh: 在我看来，澳洲是世界上最好的国家之一。
之一.pinyin: Zài wǒ kàn lái ào zhōu shì shì jiè shàng zuì hǎo de guó jiā zhī yī
之一.en: From my point of view, Australia is one of the best countries in the world.
之一.es: Desde mi punto de vista, Australia es uno de los mejores países en el mundo.

之一.zh: 他是日本最有名的歌手之一。
之一.pinyin: Tā shì rì běn zuì yǒu míng de gē shǒu zhī yī
之一.en: He is one of the most famous singers in Japan.
之一.es: Él es uno de los cantantes más famosos de Japón.

之一.zh: 这个国家的主要产品之一是咖啡。
之一.pinyin: Zhè ge guó jiā de zhǔ yào chǎn pǐn zhī yī shì kā fēi
之一.en: One of the main products of this country is coffee.
之一.es: Uno de los principales productos de este país es el café.

之一.zh: 巴黎是世界上最大的城市之一。
之一.pinyin: Bā lí shì shì jiè shàng zuì dà de chéng shì zhī yī
之一.en: Paris is one of the largest cities in the world.
之一.es: París es una de las ciudades más grandes del mundo.

王.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng shì zhōng guó rén
王.es: El Sr. Wang viene de China.

王.pinyin: Shī zǐ shì bǎi shòu zhī wáng
王.en: The lion is the king of beasts.
王.es: El león es el rey de los animales.

王.zh: 王小明说英语,但英语书不多。
王.pinyin: Wáng xiǎo míng shuō yīng yǔ dàn yīng yǔ shū bù duō
王.en: Wang Xiaoming speaks English, but doesn't have a lot of English books.
王.es: Wang Xiaoming habla inglés, pero no tiene muchos libros de inglés.

王.pinyin: Xiǎo wáng nǐ shì nǎ nián shēng de
王.en: Wang, what year were you born?

再也.zh: 他们说他再也不会回来了。
再也.pinyin: Tā men shuō tā zài yě bù huì huí lai le
再也.en: They say that he will never return.
再也.es: Se dice que él ya nunca volverá.

再也.zh: 我发誓再也不和她说话了。
再也.pinyin: Wǒ fā shì zài yě bù hé tā shuō huà le
再也.en: I vowed that I would never speak to her again.
再也.es: Juré que jamás volvería a hablar con ella.

再也.zh: 我发誓再也不跟她说话了。
再也.pinyin: Wǒ fā shì zài yě bù gēn tā shuō huà le

勋章.zh: 这名士兵被授予紫心勋章。
勋章.pinyin: Zhè míng shì bīng bèi shòu yǔ zǐ xīn xūn zhāng
勋章.en: This soldier was awarded the Purple Heart.

印刷量.zh: 他为一份印刷量很大的报纸工作。
印刷量.pinyin: Tā wèi yī fèn yìn shuā liàng hěn dà de bào zhǐ gōng zuò
印刷量.en: He works for a newspaper with a large circulation.

原件.zh: 他比较了复印稿和原件。
原件.pinyin: Tā bǐ jiào le fù yìn gǎo hé yuán jiàn
原件.en: He compared the copy with the original.
原件.es: Comparó la copia con el original.

原状.pinyin: Bǎo liú yuán zhuàng de lí kāi fáng jiān
原状.en: Leave the room as it is.

友.zh: 在权利斗争中，非友即敌。
友.pinyin: Zài quán lì dòu zhēng zhōng fēi yǒu jí dí
友.en: In a struggle of power, if you aren't with us, you're against us.

发白.pinyin: Tā xià de liǎn sè fā bái

受业.pinyin: Ràng tā men shòu yè yú wǒ men

口琴.pinyin: Nǐ huì bù huì chuī kǒu qín

吃伤.pinyin: Tā chī táng chī shāng le
吃伤.en: He was sick of eating candy.

吋.pinyin: Wǒ chà bu duō wǔ chǐ shí yī cùn

大开眼界.zh: 这部有关环境危机的纪录片真是令人大开眼界。
大开眼界.pinyin: Zhè bù yǒu guān huán jìng wēi jī de jì lù piàn zhēn shi lìng rén dà kāi yǎn jiè
大开眼界.en: That documentary about the environmental crisis was a real eye-opener.
大开眼界.es: Ese documental acerca de la crisis medioambiental me hizo abrir los ojos.

大溪地.zh: 他抛弃了家人，移居大溪地。
大溪地.pinyin: Tā pāo qì le jiā rén yí jū dà xī dì
大溪地.en: He abandoned his family and moved to Tahiti.
大溪地.es: Él abandonó a su familia y se mudó a Tahití.

天长地久.zh: 不求情意绵绵，但求天长地久。
天长地久.pinyin: Bù qiú qíng yì mián mián dàn qiú tiān cháng dì jiǔ
天长地久.en: Love me lithe, love me long.

奋不顾身.zh: 他奋不顾身地把遇溺的男孩救了起来。
奋不顾身.pinyin: Tā fèn bù gù shēn de bǎ yù nì de nán hái jiù le qǐ lai
奋不顾身.en: He saved the drowning boy at the risk of his own life.

威严.pinyin: Nǐ kàn qǐ lai hěn wēi yán

孵蛋.pinyin: Mǔ jī fū dàn fū chū xiǎo jī
孵蛋.en: A chicken hatches an egg and a chick emerges.

安全措施.zh: 广泛的安全措施实施了。
安全措施.pinyin: Guǎng fàn de ān quán cuò shī shí shī le
安全措施.en: Broad safety measures were put into effect.

岁月如梭.pinyin: Rén shēng kǔ duǎn suì yuè rú suō
岁月如梭.en: Life is short and time is swift.
岁月如梭.es: La vida es corta y el tiempo pasa veloz.

平和.zh: 我所想要的是一点平和和安静。
平和.pinyin: Wǒ suǒ xiǎng yào de shì yī diǎn píng hé hé ān jìng
平和.en: What I want is some peace and quiet.
平和.es: Lo que quiero es algo de paz y tranquilidad.

引力.zh: 爱因斯坦预测太阳的引力会弯曲光线。
引力.pinyin: Ài yīn sī tǎn yù cè tài yang de yǐn lì huì wān qū guāng xiàn
引力.en: Einstein predicted that the Sun's gravity would bend light.

引进.zh: 其中，道教是本国的，其他是从国外引进的。
引进.pinyin: Qí zhōng dào jiào shì běn guó de qí tā shì cóng guó wài yǐn jìn de
引进.en: Of these, Taoism is a native religion, the others having been introduced from foreign lands.
引进.es: De estas, el taoísmo es una religión autóctona, las otras han sido introducidas desde tierras foráneas.

性欲.zh: 老婆怀孕没了性欲我该怎么办？
性欲.pinyin: Lǎo pó huái yùn méi le xìng yù wǒ gāi zěn me bàn
性欲.en: My wife has no libido since she got pregnant. What can I do?

总合.zh: 欣赏生活中的小事，它们的总合很是宏大。
总合.pinyin: Xīn shǎng shēng huó zhòng dì xiǎo shì tā men de zǒng hé hěn shì hóng dà
总合.en: Appreciate the little things in life - they will bring you to a bigger end target.

情境.pinyin: Zuì huài de qíng jìng shì shén me
